scenario: The negative half, and the one with teeth: `engine_error` is forbidden because rung 7 HALTS THE TIER ([NCBK.2.9]) and a wrong-typed Json leaf must not. This is the difference the provenance split exists to make — the same ill-typed comparison on a non-Json-sourced value IS an EngineError, because only the artefact could have produced it. `computation_error` is forbidden too: the operation was invalid at the site, it did not merely fail to have an answer.
rules_ds:
schema Payload scope logical:
    body: Json key

rule r:
    Payload p where p.body.name > 5
->
    log info "fired"
